Hi Olivia — great speaking with you. Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

Summary (short):
- Hosted API: We operate regionally (EU, US, APAC). For EU-residency guarantees we can serve from EU regions (no customer data is routed outside the region) if you select EU-hosted tenancy. Note: we offer region pinning on paid tiers for strict residency.
- Dedicated: Reserved GPU pools in a single region (or region-paired setup). Good for predictable throughput and stronger isolation; supports customer-managed KMS.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): Full control — data never leaves your VPC; recommended when policy/regulatory requirements mandate it. Supports HSM/KMS integrations and air-gapped deployments.

Important nuances:
- Cross-region routing: For Hosted API by default we route requests to the nearest healthy region. We can set a routing policy to keep traffic strictly within EU/APAC for a given account, but if you enable global failover it may cross regions during outages (we can turn that off).
- Model availability: Most open/verified models are available EU and APAC; some larger variants and experimental quantizations are limited initially to certain regions. We'll list per-model availability in the attached matrix.
- Latency SLAs: Hosted EU endpoints meet sub-200ms p95 for typical conversational workloads; APAC latency depends on local availability — we include benchmarks in the matrix.

I attached a deployment-availability-matrix.xlsx with region-by-mode rows and recommended deployment modes per workload. Also attaching a short checklist for Dedicated vs Private (network, KMS, compliance).

Next steps:
1) Marissa (cc'd) can schedule a 30-min technical follow-up with your infra/security team to walk the matrix and run through the questionnaire.
2) If Security wants SOC2/Security artifacts we'll share them and we can start a controlled exchange via an SSO-protected repo.
3) If you want strict EU-residency with no cross-region failover, we can provision EU-only Hosted tenancy and provide contractual language for data processing.

Proposed times for a technical call: Mon/Tue 11am-2pm CET. Let me know what works and we'll set it up.

Thanks,

Hi — looping in a few answers and links so you have something concrete to review before the call.

1) Encryption: All customer traffic is TLS 1.2+ in transit. Data at rest is encrypted AES-256 by default for Hosted and Dedicated. For Dedicated and Private we support bring-your-own-KMS (AWS KMS customer-managed keys) and HSM integrations for Private/on-prem installs. Keys can be customer-managed when requested (we'll include KMS ARNs in the deployment checklist).

2) KMS/HSM: Yes — Dedicated supports BYO KMS; Private supports HSM and can be deployed behind customer-controlled networking. We'll include deployment playbooks.

3) Data flow & residency: If you choose EU-hosted tenancy with "strict residency" flag enabled, all request/response processing and logs remain in EU region(s) only. Cross-region failover is opt-in; by default we will not route traffic out of the EU. I've attached a simple network diagram in the matrix and will add a more detailed architecture diagram for the security review.

4) Audit logs: We retain platform audit logs for 90 days by default; longer retention is available as an add-on. Logs can be streamed to your SIEM via secure forwarders (Splunk HTTP Event Collector, Datadog API).

Region availability notes:
- EU (eu-west-1 / eu-central-1): Full model parity and Hosted/Dedicated/Private available today.
- APAC (ap-southeast-1 / ap-northeast-1): Most models available; a small set of large variants (>=13B) are scheduled for APAC by Q3 2027. Dedicated pools can be provisioned in APAC but with a ~4-6 week lead time depending on capacity.

- Share SOC2 snapshot + security artifacts (Aditya will send SSO link).
- Schedule a 30-min technical review with your infra/security team (Marissa to own).
- If you want a strict EU-hosted tenancy quote, we can generate one and include contractual data residency language.
